digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center backend support via shared jira-family seam
propositions: rebar must reconcile against self-hosted Jira Data Center, which differs from Cloud on three axes: REST v2 with wiki-markup/plain-text bodies (not v3 + ADF), Personal Access Token bearer auth (not ACLI subprocess), and name-based user identity (not accountId)

a shared jira_family sub-seam must be established as an explicit port layer rather than an accident of private imports, consolidating duplicated field maps and sanitizers without relocating location-pinned modules or moving the dynamic loader

the two real axes of variation—rich-text encoding (ADF for Cloud, wiki/plain text for DC) and user identity model (accountId for Cloud, name for DC)—must be pinned as contracts with one implementation per deployment, not one shared implementation
DC transport builds on the maintained pycontribs/jira library gated behind a [jira-datacenter] extra, keeping dependencies off the core engine install and the battle-tested Cloud path untouched

the DC backend must require https for reconciler.base_url and reject non-TLS URLs unless an explicit allow_insecure override is set, with certificate verification never disabled, and the PAT must be read from the JIRA_PAT environment variable only, never from file config

bidirectional reconciliation against a real Jira Data Center instance must be verified—issues created in DC must appear in the local store after an inbound pass, and local edits must appear on DC issues after an outbound pass, with zero unhandled exceptions
